subScenes.name: 询问价格
subScenes.description: 向摊主询问蔬菜的单价和促销信息。

qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 顾客询问单种蔬菜价格

followUps.text: That's $2 per pound. Fresh and ripe!
followUps.text_cn: 两美元一磅，新鲜又熟透！

followUps.text: Sorry, we just raised the price to $2.50 — supply is low this week.
followUps.text_cn: 抱歉，价格刚涨到2.5美元，这周货少。

followUps.text: You can get two pounds for $3 if you take more.
followUps.text_cn: 如果你买两磅，只要3美元。

qaPairs.usageNote: 顾客在询问具体商品价格时，摊主可能根据库存、促销或议价空间给出不同回应。

qaPairs.triggerText: What’s the price for these peppers?
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 顾客询问多种商品的总价或单价

followUps.text: Each one is $1.50, or $6 for a full bag of four.
followUps.text_cn: 每个1.5美元，一袋四个装只要6美元。

followUps.text: These are a bit spicy — they’re $2 each because they’re imported.
followUps.text_cn: 这些比较辣，是进口的，每个2美元。

followUps.text: I can let you have them for $1 each if you take all six.
followUps.text_cn: 如果你全买下六个，每个1美元给你。

qaPairs.usageNote: 顾客询问多件商品时，摊主常提供组合价或议价选项，体现市场交易灵活性。

qaPairs.triggerText: Are these apples on sale today?
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 顾客主动询问促销信息

followUps.text: Yes! Buy two, get one free — ends tonight!
followUps.text_cn: 是的！买二送一，今晚截止！

followUps.text: No sale today, but they’re already our lowest price this month.
followUps.text_cn: 今天没促销，但已经是本月最低价了。

followUps.text: We don’t have sales, but I can give you a little discount if you buy five or more.
followUps.text_cn: 我们不搞促销，但如果你买五个以上，我可以给你点折扣。

qaPairs.usageNote: 顾客询问促销时，摊主可能回应官方活动、价格底线或灵活议价，反映市场真实互动。

subScenes.name: 挑选商品
subScenes.description: 挑选新鲜蔬菜并确认品种与质量。

qaPairs.triggerText: Do you have any fresh tomatoes today?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 你们今天有新鲜的番茄吗？

followUps.text: Yes, we just got them in this morning—very sweet and firm.
followUps.text_cn: 有的，今天早上刚到的，很甜也很结实。

followUps.text: Sorry, the tomatoes sold out by noon. We have canned ones instead.
followUps.text_cn: 抱歉，番茄中午就卖完了，我们有罐装的。

followUps.text: They’re on the back shelf—slightly bruised but still good for cooking.
followUps.text_cn: 在后面的货架上，有点磕碰，但做菜没问题。

qaPairs.usageNote: 顾客常用于确认食材新鲜度，服务员回应需体现库存状态与替代方案

qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 摊主询问顾客购买意向

followUps.text: I’ll take two pounds, please.
followUps.text_cn: 我要两磅。

followUps.text: Are they on sale today? I’m just looking.
followUps.text_cn: 今天打折吗？我只是看看。

followUps.text: Can I get a discount if I buy five pounds?
followUps.text_cn: 如果我买五磅，能打折吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 摊主常用价格询问引导顾客决策，顾客回应需体现购买意愿或议价行为

qaPairs.triggerText: Which one do you recommend for stir-fry?

followUps.text: The green ones—they’re crisp and not too spicy. Perfect for stir-fry.
followUps.text_cn: 绿色的，脆嫩不辣，特别适合炒菜。

followUps.text: If you like heat, go for the red ones—they’re hotter but more flavorful.
followUps.text_cn: 如果你喜欢辣，选红色的，更辣但味道更浓。

followUps.text: Actually, the organic ones are better for stir-fry—less pesticide residue.
followUps.text_cn: 其实有机的更适合炒菜，农残更少。

qaPairs.usageNote: 顾客常寻求摊主经验建议，服务员回应需体现专业性与产品差异

subScenes.name: 确认数量
subScenes.description: 说明所需重量或数量，与摊主核对。

qaPairs.triggerText: How many pounds of tomatoes would you like?
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 菜市场买菜 - 确认数量

followUps.text: Two pounds, please.
followUps.text_cn: 请给我两磅。

followUps.text: Do you have smaller ones? I only need one pound.
followUps.text_cn: 你们有小一点的吗？我只需要一磅。

followUps.text: Hmm, let me check the price first. How much per pound?
followUps.text_cn: 嗯，我先看看价格，每磅多少钱？

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于顾客在选购蔬菜时，摊主询问数量，顾客根据需求、预算或商品规格做出回应。

qaPairs.triggerText: How many apples are you taking?
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 菜市场买菜 - 确认数量

followUps.text: Six, but can I get a discount if I buy a dozen?
followUps.text_cn: 六个，但如果我买一打能打折吗？

followUps.text: Just three—I’m not cooking today.
followUps.text_cn: 三个就够了，我今天不做饭。

followUps.text: I’ll take five, but I need them to be ripe.
followUps.text_cn: 我要五个，但必须是熟的。

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于顾客挑选水果时，摊主确认数量，顾客可能结合数量、价格、品质综合回应。

qaPairs.triggerText: How many eggs do you want?
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 菜市场买菜 - 确认数量

followUps.text: A dozen, please.
followUps.text_cn: 请给我一打。

followUps.text: I’ll take ten—I broke two last time.
followUps.text_cn: 我要十个，上次打碎了两个。

followUps.text: Actually, I’ll skip eggs today—I’ll come back tomorrow.
followUps.text_cn: 其实我今天先不买了，明天再来。

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于顾客选购易碎品如鸡蛋时，摊主确认数量，顾客可能因损耗、计划变更或价格考虑调整决定。

subScenes.name: 计算总价
subScenes.description: 确认总金额，询问是否可优惠。

qaPairs.triggerText: That'll be $12.50. How would you like to pay?
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 菜市场买菜，摊主报出总价后询问支付方式

followUps.text: I'll pay with cash.
followUps.text_cn: 我用现金支付。

followUps.text: Do you take WeChat Pay? I don't have change.
followUps.text_cn: 你们收微信支付吗？我没零钱。

followUps.text: Can I pay half cash and half by card?
followUps.text_cn: 我可以一半现金、一半刷卡吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 适用于摊主报完价后，顾客选择支付方式的典型场景，体现真实市场中灵活支付习惯

qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 总共8.75美元，现金还是刷卡？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 菜市场买菜，摊主简化支付方式询问

followUps.text: Card, please. I only have a $20 bill.
followUps.text_cn: 刷卡吧，我只有20美元钞票。

followUps.text: I'm good with cash—I’ve got exact change.
followUps.text_cn: 我用现金，正好有零钱。

followUps.text: Wait, can I just take half? I forgot my wallet.
followUps.text_cn: 等等，我能只买一半吗？我忘带钱包了。

qaPairs.usageNote: 反映顾客在支付时可能因现金不足、忘带钱包等突发状况调整决策的真实互动

qaPairs.triggerText: That comes to $15.20. How are you paying?
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 菜市场买菜，摊主确认总价后正式询问支付方式

followUps.text: Apple Pay, please.
followUps.text_cn: 请用Apple Pay。

followUps.text: I don’t have a card—can I pay with my phone?
followUps.text_cn: 我没带卡，能用手机付吗？

followUps.text: Actually, I’ll just take the tomatoes and skip the peppers—can you adjust it?
followUps.text_cn: 其实我只买番茄，不买辣椒了，能重新算一下吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 体现顾客在支付前可能临时调整购物清单，需重新计算的自然对话转折

subScenes.name: 完成付款
subScenes.description: 支付现金或扫码，礼貌道别并拿好商品。

qaPairs.triggerText: How would you like to pay?
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 菜市场买菜，完成付款环节

followUps.text: I'll pay by cash, please.
followUps.text_cn: 我用现金支付，谢谢。

followUps.text: Can I use WeChat Pay? I don't have cash on me.
followUps.text_cn: 我能用微信支付吗？我没带现金。

followUps.text: Do you take cards? I only have a debit card.
followUps.text_cn: 你们收银行卡吗？我只有借记卡。

qaPairs.usageNote: 这是菜市场付款时最常被问到的问题，顾客需根据自身支付方式灵活回应，注意口语中常省略主语或使用缩略表达。

qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 菜市场买菜，完成付款环节

followUps.text: Here's 50, keep the change.
followUps.text_cn: 给你50，不用找了。

followUps.text: Do you have smaller bills? I only have a 100-yuan note.
followUps.text_cn: 有零钱吗？我只有100元。

followUps.text: I only have 35, can I take less? Maybe skip the peppers?
followUps.text_cn: 我只有35块，能少买点吗？比如不买辣椒了？

qaPairs.usageNote: 摊主报完价后，顾客常根据手头现金或需求做出反应，回应需体现真实场景中的灵活协商。

qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 菜市场买菜，完成付款环节

followUps.text: Thanks! Have a nice day!
followUps.text_cn: 谢谢！祝你今天愉快！

followUps.text: Wait, did you give me the right change?
followUps.text_cn: 等一下，找零对吗？

followUps.text: Can I get a bag? I didn't bring one.
followUps.text_cn: 能给我个袋子吗？我没带。

qaPairs.usageNote: 付款完成后常伴随后续小需求或确认，真实对话中顾客可能在感谢后立即提出新要求，体现自然延展。
